sites.description: FastClaw is an agent factory: create, manage and run AI agents — each with its own personality, memory, skills and tools — and put them on the web, your API, or nine chat apps.
sites.home_text:
FastClaw 
 Switch language Toggle theme Get Started 
 Source-available · Single Go binary 
 Run your own AI agents. One binary. Any LLM. 
FastClaw is an agent factory: create, manage and run AI agents — each with its own personality, memory, skills and tools — and put them on the web, your API, or nine chat apps. 
 Get started free Self-host on GitHub 
 $ curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fastclaw-ai/fastclaw/main/install.sh | bash 
macOS · Linux · Windows. Drops one binary into ~/.local/bin. 
 localhost:18953/chat 
Your agents, in the chat apps your users already open 
 Telegram 
 Discord 
 Slack 
 Feishu 
 WeCom 
 WeChat 
 WhatsApp 
 LINE 
 iMessage 
 See it in action. One console for every agent. 
Chat with your agents, shape their personality, connect channels and schedule work — all from the FastClaw console. 
 Chat Agents SOUL.md Channels Scheduler 
Agents answer with rich markdown and code — here a Code Reviewer catches a SQL injection and a race condition before merge. 
 localhost:18953/chat 
 Everything an agent needs, built into the runtime. 
FastClaw handles model calls, tool execution, sandboxing, sessions and channels — so you can spend your time on what your agents do. 
 Explore all features 
Agents 
Create and run many AI agents from one FastClaw install — each with its own SOUL.md personality, memory, skills, model and sharing settings. 
Models 
Run FastClaw agents on OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Ollama, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral or any OpenAI-compatible API, with per-agent overrides and retries. 
Channels 
Bind any FastClaw agent to Telegram, Discord, Slack, Feishu, WeCom, WeChat, WhatsApp, LINE or iMessage — with per-chat session isolation and owner pairing. 
Tools & Sandbox 
Built-in exec, file and web tools, run in an E2B cloud sandbox or a Docker container, with automatic skill and workspace hydration and file sync. 
Skills & MCP 
Install skills from ClawHub, skills.sh or GitHub, connect MCP servers, add JSON-RPC plugins and let agents read Notion, GitHub and Linear. 
Runtime API 
Drive FastClaw agents from any app: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, agent management, per-end-user isolation, usage reporting and ACP. 
Scheduler 
FastClaw agents schedule their own jobs — one-off reminders, intervals or cron expressions — and deliver results to the chat that asked. 
 One directory. Everything your agents need. 
No config file to mount. The database is the source of truth; skills live on disk next to it. 
 ~/.fastclaw/ Your FastClaw home 
 ├── fastclaw.db Users, agents, sessions, keys, configs 
 ├── skills/ Shared skills — bundled + installed 
 ├── agents/ One folder per agent 
 │ └── <agentId>/agent/skills/ Agent-private skills 
 └── users/ Per-account data 
 └── <uid>/skills/ Personal skills 
Env-only bootstrap 
Port, bind, storage and sandbox come from FASTCLAW_* env vars. Everything else is edited live in the console. 
SQLite to Postgres 
Start on one SQLite file. Point FASTCLAW_STORAGE_DSN at Postgres when you go multi-pod. 
Laptop to Kubernetes 
The same binary runs in the foreground, as a launchd / systemd daemon, in Docker or on k8s. 
 Built for people who ship agents to real users. 
From a personal assistant on your Mac to the agent backend of a multi-tenant SaaS. 
 See all use cases 
SaaS builders 
Give every customer their own AI agent without building a runtime. FastClaw handles agents, end-user isolation, sandboxed tools and usage metering over an API. 
Developers 
Run your own AI agents on your laptop or server with one Go binary. Any model, local or hosted, reachable from the terminal, the web or your chat apps. 
Teams 
Deploy shared AI agents inside the chat tools your team already uses. Self-hosted, with per-person sessions, shared skills and scheduled reports. 
Communities 
Run an AI agent for your community on Telegram, Discord or LINE. Every member gets their own session, and untrusted chatters stay inside a sandbox. 
Agencies 
Build an agent once, fork it for each client, and deliver it on WeChat, WhatsApp or the web — all from one FastClaw deployment with per-client quotas. 
Running in under a minute 
Install the binary, run the setup wizard, and open the dashboard. No config files — bootstrap is env-only.

One command drops the fastclaw binary into ~/.local/bin and adds it to your PATH.

# WeClaw [中文文档](README_CN.md) WeChat AI Agent Bridge — connect WeChat to AI agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Kimi, etc.). > This project is inspired by [@tencent-weixin/openclaw-weixin](https://npmx.dev/package/@tencent-weixin/openclaw-weixin). For personal learning only, not for commercial use. | | | | |:---:|:---:|:---:| | | | | ## Quick Start ```bash # One-line install curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fastclaw-ai/weclaw/main/install.sh | sh # Start (first run will prompt QR code login) weclaw start ``` That's it. On first start, WeClaw will: 1. Show a QR code — scan with WeChat to login 2. Auto-detect installed AI agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, etc.) 3. Save config to `~/.weclaw/config.json` 4. Start receiving and replying to WeChat messages Use `weclaw login` to add additional WeChat accounts. ### Other install methods ```bash # Via Go go install github.com/fastclaw-ai/weclaw@latest # Via Docker docker run -it -v ~/.weclaw:/root/.weclaw ghcr.io/fastclaw-ai/weclaw start ``` ## How It Works

**Agent modes:** | Mode | How it works | Examples | |------|-------------|----------| | ACP | Long-running subprocess, JSON-RPC over stdio. Fastest — reuses process and sessions. | Claude, Codex, Kimi, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, OpenClaw | | CLI | Spawns a new process per message. Supports session resume via `--resume`. | Claude (`claude -p`), Codex (`codex exec`) | | HTTP | OpenAI-compatible chat completions API. | OpenClaw (HTTP fallback) | Auto-detection picks ACP over CLI when both are available. ## Chat Commands Send these as WeChat messages: | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `hello` | Send to default agent | | `/codex write a function` | Send to a specific agent | | `/cc explain this code` | Send to agent by alias | | `/claude` | Switch default agent to Claude | | `/cwd /path/to/project` | Switch workspace directory | | `/new` | Start a new conversation (clear session) | | `/info` | Show current agent info | | `/help` | Show help message | ### Aliases | Alias | Agent | |-------|-------| | `/cc` | claude | | `/cx` | codex | | `/cs` | cursor | | `/km` | kimi | | `/gm` | gemini | | `/ocd` | opencode | | `/oc` | ope

# GPTs Works
GPTs Works is a Third-party GPTs store.
## Introduction
This project consists of the following three parts👇
1. Website
code located in the `web` directory.
you can view a live demo at: [https://gpts.works](https://gpts.works)
2. Index System
code located in the `index` directory.
index system is used for searching GPTs with vector.
there is a GPTs built with index system: [https://chat.openai.com/g/g-EBKM6RsBl-gpts-works](https://chat.openai.com/g/g-EBKM6RsBl-gpts-works)
3. Browser Extension
code located in the `extension` directory.
browser extension is used to show Third-party GPTs beside ChatGPT Explore page.
## Dependencies
- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/): used for deploying website
- [Vercel Storage Postgres](https://vercel.com/docs/storage/vercel-postgres): used for storing data.
- [Zilliz Cloud](https://cloud.zilliz.com/): used for vector storing and searching
